hypothesis: When handleResolveAddress or handleResolveLink is inflight and user triggers onSave or switches items, state updates on unmounted or changed editItem can corrupt data or trigger race conditions.
The useEffect hook tracking editItem and isOpen performs setEditItem if editItem.isManualCoords is undefined, potentially causing cascading renders if parent passes a new object reference.
User-supplied link_url is accepted without protocol sanitization (e.g. javascript:), potentially allowing script execution if rendered as an href.
